senses.gloss: m. (τρῆμα, ατος, τρημάτιον) perforation, also eye of a needle; only in (בֵּיצָה) בֵּיצַת ט׳ an egg boiled down to the size of a pill which, on being swallowed by the patient, passes the body unchanged, carrying with it matter which serves the physician for diagnosis.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 6:1">Ned. VI, 1</cite> <he>ביצת טרמיטא</he> Mish. (Bab. ed. <he>ביצה טורמוט׳</he>; Y. ed. <he>טרמיטן</he>); ib. 50ᵃ <he>ביצה טורמיטא</he>; Y. ib. VI, 39ᶜ bot. <he>ביצה טרומיטא</he>, expl. <cite ref="T00424"><he>רופיטון</he></cite>.
